ctx.x: I'm gonna write...write the story, and I sit down and wrote the story of Biddy Mason, and I got permission from great grandchildren, you know, got a letter over there, and it's okay to do anything I want with it. And then I got hold to scrap of paper...somethin' 'bout Stagecoach Mary, and I sent up to the library in Idaho, and they sent me all of this stuff, y'know, so I wrote that.
And then, I don't know, I got a lot of ideas that I could put down.
